component.name: Linux Crap Cleaner
component.summary: Find what's filling your disk and clean it safely

description.p: A friendly system cleaner in the spirit of CCleaner. It shows what takes up space and removes junk safely: nothing is deleted until you've seen a preview and confirmed, files go to the Trash by default, and system and private files are always protected.

ul.li: Junk Cleaner: browser, app and developer caches, old package versions, logs, old Snap versions
Storage Analyzer: see which folders are biggest in a clickable ring chart
System Leftovers: orphan packages, unused Flatpak runtimes, settings of removed apps, broken launchers
Installed Software: every package, Flatpak, Snap and AppImage with its size
Duplicates and big files, compared by content
App Usage: apps you haven't opened for months

description.p: Works with pacman (Arch, CachyOS, Manjaro), APT (Debian, Ubuntu, Mint), DNF (Fedora) and Zypper (openSUSE). Tasks that need administrator rights ask for your password through polkit.
